definitions.explanation: To talk over differing opinions, plans or conditions until they fit together. Literally, to rub two things together so that they fit closely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{合|あ}わせる。
⟦{両社|りょうしゃ}→両社：31608_ryousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: We coordinated the two companies' schedules.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧どうし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{合|あ}わせておく⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Before the meeting, the departments need to work out the details among themselves.

notes:
Common in business Japanese. The noun すり{合|あ}わせ (coordination, alignment) is just as frequent: ⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すり{合|あ}わせ (advance coordination).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{合|あ}わせる: to reconcile opinions
- ⟦{認識|にんしき}→認識：05090_ninshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{合|あ}わせる: to get on the same page
- ⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{合|あ}わせる: to coordinate schedules

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧: to adjust, to coordinate; the general word
- ⟦{根回|ねまわ}し→根回し：07727_nemawashi⟧: quietly sounding out each person before a decision

WRITING:
The kanji spelling {擦|す}り{合|あ}わせる is less common.
